# Pure geometry tests keep the expected result outside the function input

The unit task destructures trigger, container, dialog and result from each fixture, passes only the three input fields to getIdealDialogPosition, and compares x/y afterward. Review requests this so returning an input result field cannot satisfy the test. The browser helper can receive the full fixture because it unpacks inputs before exercising the dialog; the two boundaries differ. This is a test-design lesson, not a claim those many fixtures cover every geometry case. No test ran.

Scope: Calendar geometry test inputs.
